name: zpk_care
description: Pharmacy-benefit claims adjudicated with zero-knowledge proofs: identities stay on the member's phone

scripts.start:leviathan:clean: npm run kill:ports && npm run clean:state && npx tsx src/nodes/start-leviathan.ts
scripts.start:leviathan:clean:100: npm run kill:ports && npm run clean:state && node -e "require('child_process').execSync('npx tsx src/nodes/start-leviathan.ts',{stdio:'inherit',env:{...process.env,ZKTRIDENT_FORMULARY_LIMIT:'100',ZKTRIDENT_POOL_SIZE:'2',ZKTRIDENT_PROOF_POOL_SIZE:'4'}})"
scripts.start:leviathan:clean:100:unsecure: npm run kill:ports && npm run clean:state && node -e "require('child_process').execSync('npx tsx src/nodes/start-leviathan.ts',{stdio:'inherit',env:{...process.env,ZKTRIDENT_FORMULARY_LIMIT:'100',ZKTRIDENT_POOL_SIZE:'2',ZKTRIDENT_PROOF_POOL_SIZE:'4',ZKTRIDENT_UNSECURE:'true'}})"
scripts.bootstrap:clean: npm run kill:ports && npm run clean:state && npx tsx scripts/bootstrap-system.ts --skip-kill

author: Ben Humbert
